PNP: No untoward incidents at Forbes Park rally

MANILA, Philippines — No untoward incidents were reported at a rally outside the Forbes Park Village in Makati City, the Philippine National Police (PNP) said Monday.

The rally outside the gated community took place Sunday night, calling on President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to step down over the flood control controversy, and was briefly joined by Cavite 4th District Rep. Kiko Barzaga
